w.name: Vivid Notions
w.text: Provides 44.1% CRIT DMG, 28% ATK, and up to 68% Plunging Attack CRIT DMG at R1, making it Varesa’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: Kagura's Verity
w.text: Provides 66.2% CRIT DMG and boosts Elemental Skill DMG and overall Elemental DMG, making it a strong 5-star alternative for Varesa.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and a random ATK, Elemental DMG, or EM buff, offering strong but inconsistent damage boosts for Varesa.

w.name: Flowing Purity
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and a random ATK, Elemental DMG, or EM buff, offering strong but inconsistent damage boosts for Varesa.

a.text: Provides 27.6% ATK and up to 40% Elemental DMG Bonus at R5, making it a strong craftable F2P option for Varesa when paired with a healer.
Provides 15% DMG Bonus and 40% CRIT Rate while Varesa is in Nightsoul’s Blessing, making it her best-in-slot artifact set.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Provides 36% ATK, making it a solid 2-piece combination for boosting Varesa’s Plunging Attack damage.

t.name: Plunge & Punishment
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Mavuika adds off-field Pyro and buffs, Iansan boosts ATK, and Chevreuse provides healing, ATK buffs, and Pyro/Electro RES shred.

t.name: Natlan CrossFit
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Durin adds off-field Pyro, Iansan boosts ATK, and Chevreuse heals, buffs ATK, and shreds Pyro/Electro RES.

t.name: Air Traffic Control
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Furina provides Hydro application and DMG buffs, Iansan boosts ATK, and Xianyun buffs Plunging Attacks and heals.

t.name: Bat Mobile
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Mavuika provides off-field Pyro and buffs, Ororon adds Electro damage and Scroll buffs, and Chevreuse heals, boosts ATK, and shreds Pyro/Electro RES.

w.name: Fang of the Mountain King
w.text: Provides 11% CRIT Rate and boosts Elemental Skill and Burst DMG by up to 60% at R1, making it Kinich’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: A Thousand Blazing Suns
w.text: Provides 11% CRIT Rate and, at R1, grants 28% ATK and 20% CRIT DMG, making it a strong 5-star alternative for Kinich.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: Provides 27.6% CRIT Rate and up to 30% DMG Bonus at R1, making it a strong 4-star option for Kinich. Its stacks are reduced when he takes damage.

w.name: Earth Shaker
w.text: Provides 27.6% ATK and up to 32% Elemental Skill DMG at R5 after a Pyro reaction, making it a strong craftable F2P option for Kinich.

a.text: Provides 15% DMG Bonus and 40% CRIT Rate while Kinich consumes Nightsoul points, making it his best-in-slot artifact set.
Provides 18% ATK and up to 50% DMG Bonus while Burning enemies are present, making it a strong alternative for Kinich in Burning teams.
Provides 15% Dendro DMG and 20% Elemental Skill DMG, offering a flexible option for boosting Kinich’s Dendro and Skill damage.

t.name: Kinich Me Outside
t.text: Kinich drives on-field Burning damage, Emilie adds off-field Dendro damage, Nicole provides ATK buffs and shielding, and Durin supplies Pyro application, Dendro RES shred, and off-field damage.

t.name: Ajaw & Order
t.text: Kinich deals the damage and Bennett buffs the team.

t.name: Let Him Cook
t.text: Kinich drives Burning damage, Iansan boosts ATK and DMG, Bennett provides ATK buffs and healing, and Xiangling supplies off-field Pyro damage.

t.name: Free to Burn
t.text: Kinich drives Burning damage, Pyro Traveler provides off-field Pyro and buffs, Bennett boosts ATK and heals, and Iansan adds ATK buffs and DMG Bonus.

w.name: Disaster and Remorse
w.text: Provides 22.1% CRIT Rate and boosts Normal, Charged, Skill, and Burst DMG by 40% at R1. Its bonuses increase by 75% with Hexerei: Secret Rite, making it Lohen’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: Staff of Homa
w.text: Provides 66.2% CRIT DMG, 20% HP, and an ATK bonus based on Max HP, making it a strong 5-star alternative for Lohen.

w.name: Deathmatch
w.text: Provides 36.8% CRIT Rate and up to 24% ATK at R1 against fewer than two enemies, making it a strong 4-star alternative for Lohen.

w.name: Missive Windspear
w.text: Provides 41.3% ATK and, at R5, grants 24% ATK and 96 EM after triggering an Elemental Reaction, making it a solid F2P option for Lohen.

w.name: Tamayuratei no Ohanashi
w.text: stacks granted on Skill use — the combo already casts Skill once every cycle.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Provides 18% ATK and up to 25% additional ATK plus 20% CRIT Rate after Witch’s Homework, making it Lohen’s best-in-slot artifact set.
Provides 15% Cryo DMG and up to 40% CRIT Rate against Cryo-affected or Frozen enemies, making it a situational alternative for Lohen in Freeze teams.
Provides 15% Normal and Charged Attack DMG and up to 36% CRIT Rate when HP changes, making it a situational option for Lohen if his team provides consistent HP fluctuations.

t.name: Witch Please
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage and enables Forward Melt, Durin provides off-field Pyro and Melt damage, Nicole buffs the team and shields, and Citlali shreds Pyro RES and boosts damage.

t.name: Blizzard Queen
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage, Furina provides Hydro application and DMG buffs, Citlali adds shielding and Cryo application, and Escoffier provides healing, Cryo RES shred, and off-field damage.

t.name: Amber Alerted Us
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage, Vodyanitsa provides Hydro application, healing, and RES shred, Mona boosts damage with Omen, and Escoffier adds Cryo/Hydro RES shred and healing.

t.name: Lohen at Home
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage and triggers Reverse Melt, Xiangling provides off-field Pyro, Bennett buffs ATK and heals, and Sucrose boosts EM and enables Hexerei synergy.

w.name: Azurelight
w.text: Provides 22.1% CRIT Rate and, at R1, grants 48% ATK and 40% CRIT DMG when Skirk has 0 Energy after using her Skill. Her signature weapon and best-in-slot choice.

w.name: Haran Geppaku Futsu
w.text: Provides 33.1% CRIT Rate and 12% Elemental DMG Bonus, with additional Normal Attack DMG after using Skirk’s Skill. A strong 5-star alternative and one of her best non-signature weapons.

w.name: Calamity of Eshu
w.text: Provides 27.6% ATK and, at R5, grants 40% Normal and Charged Attack DMG plus 16% CRIT Rate while shielded. An excellent F2P option for on-field Skirk, but much weaker for quickswap play.

w.name: Finale of the Deep
w.text: Provides 27.6% ATK and, at R5, grants 24% ATK after using an Elemental Skill, plus up to 300 bonus ATK when its Bond of Life is cleared. Skirk’s best freely accessible 4-star option, especially with a healer to clear the Bond of Life.

a.text: Provides 27.6% ATK and increases ATK after using an Elemental Skill. Its Bond of Life effect can add another ATK boost once cleared, making it a solid craftable option for Skirk.

Provides 15% Normal and Charged Attack DMG and up to 36% CRIT Rate when HP changes. Furina reliably activates the full bonus through her HP drain, making this a strong option for on-field Skirk. Watch your CRIT Rate, especially with Azurelight—the set can cause overcapping.

Provides 18% ATK and 35% Normal Attack DMG for sword users. A decent temporary set for on-field Skirk, but it doesn't boost her Burst or Skill damage, so prioritize pieces with strong CRIT and ATK substats while farming Finale of the Deep Galleries

t.name: ABYSS & BOUJE
t.text: Skirk leads on-field Cryo damage, Furina provides off-field Hydro and a massive teamwide DMG Bonus, Vodyanitsa adds Hydro support, RES shred, and powerful damage buffs, while Escoffier provides Cryo application, additional RES shred, and healing.

t.name: FROST & FURIOUS
t.text: Skirk deals on-field Cryo damage, Furina buffs and applies Hydro, Citlali shields and shreds RES, and Escoffier heals while boosting Cryo/Hydro damage.

t.name: COLD HARD FACTS
t.text: Skirk deals on-field Cryo damage, Xingqiu provides off-field Hydro, Charlotte offers teamwide healing and TTDS buffs, and Escoffier heals while shredding Cryo/Hydro RES.

t.name: BUDGET ABYSS
t.text: Skirk deals on-field Cryo damage, Xingqiu provides off-field Hydro, Rosaria boosts CRIT Rate and adds Cryo damage, and Dahlia shields Skirk while increasing her Attack SPD.

w.name: Lightbearing Moonshard
w.text: Provides 88.2% CRIT DMG and, at R1, grants 20% DEF and 64% Lunar-Crystallize DMG for 5 seconds after using an Elemental Skill. Zibai’s signature weapon and best-in-slot choice, directly boosting her DEF scaling and reaction damage.

w.name: Uraku Misugiri
w.text: Provides 88.2% CRIT DMG and, at R1, grants 20% DEF and 24% Elemental Skill DMG, doubled to 40% DEF and 48% Skill DMG after nearby Geo damage. Zibai’s second-best weapon, offering excellent CRIT and DEF, but less Lunar-Crystallize damage than her signature.

w.name: Flute of Ezpitzal
w.text: Provides 69% DEF and, at R5, grants an additional 32% DEF for 15 seconds after using an Elemental Skill. Zibai’s best craftable F2P weapon, offering excellent DEF for her Lunar-Crystallize damage.

w.name: Harbinger of Dawn
w.text: Provides 46.9% CRIT DMG and, at R5, grants 28% CRIT Rate while Zibai stays above 90% HP. Her best non-5-star weapon, since her DEF scaling makes its low Base ATK irrelevant. A shielder or reliable healer helps maintain the passive.

a.text: Provides 80 EM and up to 30% CRIT Rate when Lunar Reactions trigger at Ascendant Gleam. Also grants the team a 10% Lunar Reaction DMG Bonus. Zibai’s best-in-slot artifact set, maximizing her Lunar-Crystallize damage while buffing the team.

Provides 30% DEF and up to 24% additional DEF and 24% Geo DMG Bonus at max stacks. A solid temporary set for Zibai, boosting her DEF scaling, but significantly weaker than Night of the Sky’s Unveiling for Lunar-Crystallize damage.

Provides 80 EM and 35% Charged Attack DMG for Catalyst and Bow users. Since Zibai uses a sword, the 4-piece bonus does not activate. The 2-piece EM bonus is usable, but this is not a recommended full set for her.

t.name: Crater Expectations
t.text: Zibai leads on-field Lunar-Crystallize damage, Columbina provides off-field Hydro and Lunar buffs, Linnea adds Geo RES shred, healing, and EM buffs, and Illuga boosts Geo and Lunar-Crystallize damage.

t.name: Geo Force One
t.text: Zibai leads on-field Lunar-Crystallize damage, Columbina provides off-field Hydro and Lunar buffs, Illuga boosts Geo and Lunar-Crystallize damage, and Gorou adds DEF and Geo DMG buffs.

t.name: OSMANTHUS WHINES
t.text: Zibai leads on-field Lunar-Crystallize damage, Columbina provides off-field Hydro and Lunar buffs, Illuga boosts Geo and Lunar-Crystallize damage, and Zhongli provides shielding and universal RES shred.

t.name: Columbina at Home
t.text: Zibai leads on-field Lunar-Crystallize damage, Illuga provides major Geo and Lunar reaction buffs, Aino supplies off-field Hydro application, and Gorou boosts DEF and Geo damage.

w.name: Golden Frostbound Oath
w.text: Provides 88.2% CRIT DMG and, at R1, grants 16% DEF, 40% Geo DMG, and 40% Lunar-Crystallize DMG to Linnea. When Moondrifts are nearby, teammates also gain 20% Geo and Lunar-Crystallize DMG. Linnea’s signature weapon and best-in-slot choice.

w.name: Aqua Simulacra
w.text: Provides 88.2% CRIT DMG and, at R1, increases damage by 20% when enemies are nearby, even while Linnea is off-field. An excellent 5-star alternative for maximizing her personal damage, though it lacks the DEF and team buffs of her signature.

w.name: Slingshot
w.text: Provides 31.2% CRIT Rate and, at R5, grants 60% Normal and Charged Attack DMG when hits land within 0.3 seconds of firing. A budget option for Linnea, but its low Base ATK and conditional passive make it a considerable step down from her 5-star choices.

w.name: Covenant of Frost and Snow
w.text: Provides 51.7% DEF and, at R5, grants 240 Elemental Mastery for 12 seconds after using an Elemental Skill. A strong craftable option for Linnea, boosting her Lunar-Crystallize reaction damage, though it lacks the CRIT DMG and team buffs of her signature.

a.text: Provides 80 EM and increases the wearer’s Lunar Reaction DMG by 20% while off-field, rising to 60% with Ascendant Gleam. An excellent set for boosting Linnea’s personal Lunar-Crystallize damage.

Provides 20% Energy Recharge and, at 4-piece, grants the team up to 120 EM and a 10% Lunar Reaction DMG Bonus. Linnea can activate the effect off-field, making this a strong support option when no other teammate carries the set.

Provides 30% DEF and up to 24% additional DEF and 24% Geo DMG Bonus at max stacks. A strong option for Linnea, boosting both her DEF scaling and personal Geo damage, though Aubade is generally better for Lunar-Crystallize damage.

t.name: Crater Expectations
t.text: Zibai leads on-field Lunar-Crystallize damage, Columbina provides off-field Hydro and Lunar buffs, Linnea adds Geo RES shred, healing, and EM buffs, and Illuga boosts Geo and Lunar-Crystallize damage.

t.name: Guns & Rosés
t.text: Navia leads on-field Geo damage, Columbina provides Hydro application and Lunar reaction buffs, Linnea adds Geo RES shred, healing, and EM buffs, and Furina supplies off-field Hydro and a powerful teamwide DMG Bonus.

t.name: OniFans
t.text: Itto leads on-field Geo damage, Linnea provides off-field damage, healing, and Geo RES shred, Columbina enables Lunar-Crystallize with Hydro application, and Illuga boosts Geo and Lunar-Crystallize damage.

t.name: Hopeless Impact
t.text: Noelle leads on-field Geo damage and provides healing, Linnea adds off-field damage, Geo RES shred, and healing, Aino enables Hydro application and Lunar-Crystallize, and Illuga boosts Geo and Lunar reaction damage.

w.name: Reliquary of Truth
w.text: Provides 88.2% CRIT DMG, 8% CRIT Rate, 120 EM, and up to 36% additional CRIT DMG at R1, making it Nefer’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: Nightweaver's Looking Glass
w.text: Provides 265 EM and boosts Lunar-Bloom DMG by 40% at R1, making it Nefer’s second-best weapon behind Reliquary of Truth.

w.name: Dawning Frost
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and up to 216 EM at R1 after hitting with Charged Attacks and Elemental Skills, making it a strong 4-star option for Nefer

w.name: Blackmarrow Lantern
w.text: Provides 221 EM and up to 24% Lunar-Bloom DMG at R5, making it Nefer’s best craftable F2P option.

a.text: Provides 80 EM and up to 30% CRIT Rate, while increasing teamwide Lunar Reaction DMG by 10%. Nefer’s best-in-slot set for Lunar-Bloom teams.
Provides 80 EM and up to 150 additional EM or 28% ATK, boosting Nefer’s Lunar-Bloom and reaction damage.
Provides 160 EM, boosting Nefer’s Lunar-Bloom damage and reaction scaling. A solid transitional option while farming her 4-piece set.

t.name: Petal to the Meta
t.text: Nefer drives Lunar-Bloom damage, Lauma provides major Lunar-Bloom buffs and Dendro RES shred, Nahida boosts EM, and Columbina supplies off-field Hydro and Lunar-Bloom buffs.

t.name: Petty Petals
t.text: Nefer drives Lunar-Bloom damage, Columbina provides Hydro application and Lunar buffs, Aino adds Hydro application and reaction buffs, and Nahida boosts EM and provides off-field Dendro damage.

t.name: Bloom With a View
t.text: Nefer drives Lunar-Bloom damage, Columbina provides Hydro and Lunar buffs, Lauma amplifies Lunar-Bloom, and Ineffa adds shielding, off-field damage, and extra reaction support.

t.name: Broke But Blooming
t.text: Nefer drives Lunar-Bloom damage, Aino provides Hydro application and Lunar buffs, Kirara supplies Dendro application and shielding, and Sucrose boosts EM.

why.v: Sustain: Optional depending on the team. Nefer's dash-heavy gameplay offers substantial protection, but a healer or shielder can make rotations more comfortable.. Lauma C1 makes Nefer teams much more comfortable.

w.name: A Teaspoon of Transcendence
w.text: Provides 44.1% CRIT DMG and 28% ATK, plus up to 48% Stellar-Conduct DMG at R1 through Charged Attack stacks. Sandrone’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: A Thousand Blazing Suns
w.text: Provides 11% CRIT Rate and, at R1, grants 28% ATK and 20% CRIT DMG after using an Elemental Skill or Burst. A strong 5-star alternative and Sandrone’s second-best weapon.

w.name: Mailed Flower
w.text: Provides 110 EM and, at R5, grants 24% ATK and 96 EM after triggering an Elemental Reaction or hitting with an Elemental Skill, making it a solid 4-star option for Sandrone.

w.name: Blade of Atonement
w.text: Provides 27.6% ATK and up to 128 EM plus 32% ATK at R5 after triggering reactions, making it a strong craftable F2P option for Sandrone in Stellar-Conduct teams.

a.text: Provides 18% ATK and boosts Stellar-Conduct DMG by 40%, with 16% CRIT Rate against affected enemies. Sandrone’s best-in-slot artifact set for Stellar-Conduct teams.
Provides 80 EM and, at 4-piece, grants up to 42% ATK and 150 EM based on team composition, making it a strong alternative for Sandrone’s Stellar-Conduct damage.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Provides 36% ATK, making it a solid transitional set for boosting Sandrone’s personal damage.

t.name: Marionette Mayhem
t.text: Sandrone drives on-field Stellar-Conduct damage, Mitya provides off-field Electro and reaction damage, Odette adds off-field Cryo and Stellar damage buffs, and Nicole provides ATK buffs and shielding.

t.name: The Puppet Protocol
t.text: Sandrone deals the damage, Yae Miko adds off-field damage and qiqi buffs the team.

t.name: Strings Attached
t.text: Sandrone leads on-field Stellar-Conduct damage, Yae provides off-field Electro and reaction damage, Escoffier adds Cryo application and RES shred, and Sucrose boosts EM while reducing enemy resistance with Viridescent Venerer.

t.name: Spare Parts Squad
t.text: Sandrone leads on-field Stellar-Conduct damage, Beidou provides off-field Electro and C6 reaction buffs, Qiqi supplies healing, Cryo application, and Stellar-Conduct buffs, while Sucrose shares EM and shreds resistance with Viridescent Venerer.

w.name: Whitelake Frostfeather
w.text: Provides 22.1% CRIT Rate, up to 24% ATK, and 50% Stellar Glimmer CRIT DMG at R1, plus Energy restoration. Odette’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: Azurelight
w.text: Provides 22.1% CRIT Rate, 24% ATK, and up to an additional 24% ATK and 40% CRIT DMG when Odette has zero Energy, making it a strong 5-star alternative.

w.name: Emberwell
w.text: Provides 165 EM and up to 32% ATK plus 32% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG at R5, making it Odette’s strongest craftable 4-star option for personal damage

w.name: Finale of the Deep
w.text: Provides 27.6% ATK and up to 24% additional ATK at R5, plus up to 300 flat ATK when its Bond of Life is cleared. A strong craftable 4-star option for Odette.

w.name: Xiphos' Moonlight
w.text: R 1 + Elemental Mastery Small ATK and Energy Recharge support option.

w.name: Harbinger of Dawn
w.text: R 1 + CRIT DMG Effective F2P CRIT DMG sword; keep HP above 90% to gain the 14% CRIT Rate bonus.

a.text: Provides 18% ATK and boosts teamwide Stellar Glimmer DMG by 50% when the wearer triggers or deals Stellar Glimmer damage, making it one of Odette’s best-in-slot support sets.

Provides 18% ATK and boosts Stellar-Conduct damage by 40%, with 16% CRIT Rate against affected enemies. A strong personal-damage set for Odette in Stellar-Conduct teams, especially when another teammate carries Heart of the Furnace.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Provides 36% ATK, making it a flexible option for boosting Odette’s personal damage.

t.name: Puppet Masters
t.text: Odette enables and buffs Stellar-Conduct, Sandrone drives on-field damage, Yae adds off-field Electro damage, and Nicole provides ATK buffs and shielding.

t.name: Icebreaker
t.text: Wriothesley drives on-field Stellar-Conduct damage, Odette enables and buffs Stellar-Conduct, Yae provides off-field Electro damage, and Nicole supplies ATK buffs and shielding.

t.name: Slumber Party
t.text: Mizuki drives on-field Stellar Swirl damage, Odette enables and buffs Stellar Swirl, Cryo Traveler provides off-field Cryo and reaction buffs, and Sucrose boosts EM and shreds RES.

t.name: Discount Detectives
t.text: Heizou drives on-field Stellar Swirl damage, Odette provides off-field Cryo and enables Stellar Swirl, Fischl adds off-field Electro damage, and Barbara provides healing and Hydro application.

w.name: Cashflow Supervision
w.text: Provides 22.1% CRIT Rate and, at R1, grants 16% ATK, up to 48% Normal Attack DMG and 42% Charged Attack DMG through HP fluctuations, plus 8% ATK SPD at max stacks. Wriothesley’s BiS weapon.

w.name: Tulaytullah's Remembrance
w.text: Provides 44.1% CRIT DMG and, at R1, grants 10% ATK SPD and up to 48% Normal Attack DMG after using his Skill and landing Normal Attacks. An excellent 5-star alternative, just behind Cashflow Supervision.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and, at R5, grants a random 10-second buff: 120% ATK, 96% Elemental DMG Bonus, or 480 EM. A strong 4-star option for Wriothesley, especially at high refinements, though its random passive makes performance inconsistent

w.name: Ballad of the Boundless Blue
w.text: Provides 30.6% Energy Recharge and, at R5, grants up to 48% Normal Attack DMG and 36% Charged Attack DMG after hitting enemies. A solid F2P option for Wriothesley, especially if he needs extra Energy Recharge.

w.name: Mappa Mare
w.text: Craftable Elemental Mastery choice; triggering Melt reliably procs its Elemental DMG Bonus.

a.text: Provides 18% ATK and boosts Stellar-Conduct DMG by 40%, with 16% CRIT Rate against affected enemies. Wriothesley’s best-in-slot set for Stellar-Conduct teams, though Marechaussee Hunter remains strong for his other playstyles.

Provides 15% Normal and Charged Attack DMG and up to 36% CRIT Rate when HP fluctuates. Wriothesley’s best-in-slot set for traditional Freeze and Melt teams, with excellent synergy from his HP mechanics.

Provides 15% Cryo DMG and up to 40% CRIT Rate against Cryo-affected or Frozen enemies. A strong option for Freeze teams, but Wriothesley’s Charged Attacks can Shatter enemies and reduce Freeze uptime. Marechaussee Hunter is generally more flexible

t.name: Conducted Chaos
t.text: Wriothesley leads on-field Stellar-Conduct damage, Mitya adds off-field Electro damage, Odette enables and buffs Stellar-Conduct, and Nicole provides shielding and teamwide ATK buffs.

t.name: Freeze Frame
t.text: Wriothesley leads on-field Cryo damage, Furina provides Hydro and a massive teamwide DMG Bonus, Shenhe boosts Cryo damage, and Escoffier heals while shredding Cryo/Hydro RES.

t.name: Fire Meets Frost
t.text: Wriothesley drives on-field Melt damage, Durin provides Pyro application, Nicole delivers teamwide ATK buffs, and Xilonen shreds Cryo/Pyro RES while boosting damage.

t.name: Frost on a Budget
t.text: Wriothesley drives Reverse Melt damage, Xiangling provides off-field Pyro, Sucrose shares EM and shreds Cryo RES, and Bennett supplies ATK buffs, healing, and Pyro energy.
